findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "stream" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sqlguard_denials, sqlguard_probe · Private data: sqlguard_sprint, sqlguard_client · Public sink: sqlguard_handshake, sqlguard_challenge, sqlguard_pilot, sqlguard_denials, sqlguard_gate, sqlguard_workday, sqlguard_sprint, sqlguard_bind, sqlguard_protocol · Destructive: sqlguard_verify, sqlguard_gate, sqlguard_sprint, sqlguard_bind, sqlguard_probe, sqlguard_cert, sqlguard_validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sqlguard_denials, sqlguard_probe · Private data: sqlguard_sprint, sqlguard_client · Public sink: sqlguard_handshake, sqlguard_challenge, sqlguard_pilot, sqlguard_denials, sqlguard_gate, sqlguard_workday, sqlguard_sprint, sqlguard_bind, sqlguard_protocol · Destructive: sqlguard_verify, sqlguard_gate, sqlguard_sprint, sqlguard_bind, sqlguard_probe, sqlguard_cert, sqlguard_validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
